hero.eyebrow: Semantic vs keyword: when each fails
hero.hero-sub: Choosing between semantic and keyword search defines your retrieval accuracy, latency, and ability to answer user intent. Semantic search excels at synonyms and context but fails on exact matches and rare terms. Keyword search is fast and precise but misses meaning — hybrid search combines both for robust answer engine optimization (AEO).
